The game records and artwork cached by SynthScan are extracted locally from
the user's installed Star Citizen client. Game content is attributed to Cloud
Imperium Games. Asset references, game build and hashes are retained in
data/local_game_library.json. These assets are not SynthScan-created artwork.

StarBreaker v0.3.2 is the extraction/conversion tool (MIT; see
third_party/starbreaker/LICENSE). Its license does not cover CIG game content.

resvg-py 0.5.0 performs local SVG rasterization during maintenance refreshes.
Its license is copied alongside this notice as resvg-py-LICENSE.
